author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Independent desktop and phone review plus the two bounded accessibility corrections

changes.problem: Existing quiet styling hid the essential source basis, original PDF link and checklist-versus-completion sentence.
changes.fix: Use component-specific paragraph classes rather than the existing sub/norate classes.
changes.verified: The complete source basis and original PDF link are visible in both screenshots and rendered text.

changes.problem: The globally sticky first table column permanently covered the beginning of phone prerequisite text.
changes.fix: Only tables inside data-cw2-plan803 use static first cells.
changes.verified: Ordinary horizontal scrolling reaches both the beginning and end of QPS prerequisites without first-column obstruction.

visualReview: Desktop and phone week header, all three unresolved quantity-conflict rows, Friday row, and the phone prerequisite scroll positions were inspected. No remaining blocker within this bounded plan-only review.
limitations: Phone tables retain horizontal scrolling; long prerequisite lines are read by panning between their beginning and end.
This plan-only review does not establish editable requirement-confirmation behavior; that integration has separate evidence.
